content.text: topical lidocaine (or capsaicin) may be used for neuropathic pain in early CRPS w mild-mod Sx; evidence = limited, & local burning or irritate may limit use

Apply to intact skin over most painful area; max 3 patches once for up to 12 h w.in a 24-h period. If irritate/burning occurs during application, remove patch(es) & do ⍉reapply until irritate subsides. ⍉ H2O contact (bathing · swimming · showering) — LIDODERM may ⍉stick if it gets wet
Keep out of reach of children/pets - fold used patches so adhesive sticks to itself & discard safely. CI: known Hx of sensitivity to amide-type local anesthetics or other components

Methemoglobinemia: suscep pts incl G6PD deficiency · congenital/idiopathic methemoglobinemia · ♡/pulm compromise · infants <6 mo · concurrent oxidizing agents. Immediate tx required to avert CNS/CV effects (sz · coma · arrhythmias · death) - d/c LIDODERM & any other oxidizing agents. Even a used patch contains ≥665 mg lidocaine — sm child or pet may suffer serious effects from chewing or ingesting a new or used patch. Excessive dosing (lrger areas or longer than recommended wearing time) may ↑ absorb & blood concentrations → serious SE. Lidocaine toxicity expected @ blood concentrations above 5 mcg/mL

Severe hepatic dz ↑ risk of toxic blood concentrations (impaired met). Apply only to intact skin - application to broken/inflamed skin may ↑ blood concentrations. Use caution w Class I antiarrhythmics (tocainide · mexiletine) — toxic effects additive & potentially synergistic. OD mgmt: close monitoring · supportive care · Sxtomatic tx - dialysis of negligible value
